rationale: Archive GridPoint from the infrastructure PortCo list. The company provides energy-management software, controls, analytics and services for customer-owned commercial buildings; no material owned generation, storage, utility, transmission, distribution or building portfolio was verified. I Squared's interest is through its InfraTech venture and growth strategy, while other disclosed investments are climate-growth, corporate-venture or financing exposures rather than qualifying direct infrastructure ownership.

supports: I Squared describes InfraTech as a venture and growth strategy
GridPoint sells energy-management technology and services
The 2022 transaction was a strategic capital raise

beforeImage.name: GridPoint
beforeImage.subsector: Distributed energy management software and controls
beforeImage.description: GridPoint provides energy-management software, controls, and analytics for commercial buildings. Its customers are multi-site commercial and industrial building owners and operators that use the platform to reduce energy costs, improve resilience, and optimize distributed equipment. The business follows an asset-light technology model centered on software subscriptions, controls hardware, and recurring service revenues rather than ownership of regulated utility assets. Public materials state that the company was founded in 2003 and that its platform manages energy performance across more than 15,000 commercial buildings. I Squared's own history identifies GridPoint as the first investment of the Global InfraTech Fund, launched in 2021; later 2022 financing materials continued to identify I Squared among GridPoint's investors. The resulting ownership percentage is not publicly disclosed. The company sits at the intersection of energy efficiency, grid responsiveness, and commercial-building digitization.

milestones.event: Public materials identify GridPoint’s founding year.
I Squared's Global InfraTech Fund launched and made GridPoint its first investment.
GridPoint announced a $75 million strategic capital raise and identified I Squared Capital among its investors.
GridPoint announced additional financing to support commercial-building electrification growth.
